Lessons: The Apostolic Church; Persecution and Martyrs; Councils and Creeds; Monks, Missionaries and the Middle Ages; The Reformation; Revivals and Global Missions; The Church in the Modern World; Lessons for the Church Today
Description: Your faith has a family story stretching back two thousand years. Travel through persecution, councils, reform and revival to meet the men and women who carried the gospel before us, learning from their courage and their mistakes alike. History, told warmly and honestly.
